text: Dear Chair and Colleagues, I've been contacted by several residents concerned about road safety in the vicinity of Wanless Park. There is a blind corner at Wanless Crescent and Rothmere Drive that is very dangerous for motorists operating at high speeds. Wanless Crescent is used by many families and children walking to Wanless Park, while Rothmere Drive is used by many students walking to and from the Toronto French School. Transportation Services staff do not object to the requested changes.

North York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 40km/h to 30km/h on Wanless Crescent, between Lawrence Avenue East and Rothmere Drive/Braeside Road. 2. Reduced the speed limit from 40km/h to 30km/h on Rothmere Drive, between Braeside Drive/Wanless Crescent and Mildenhall Road.
